fields.description: LiteLLM model identifier. With a Provider linked, pick or type just the model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6); otherwise use provider/model form, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, openai/gpt-4.1, ollama/llama3.1
fields.label: Model ID

fields.description: Max input tokens. Auto-detected from the model on save; managed by Flow, not user-editable. 0 = unknown.
fields.label: Context Window

fields.description: API key to authenticate with this model's endpoint. Needed when no Provider is linked.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Endpoint for this model, e.g. a self-hosted Ollama (http://localhost:11434) or a proxy. Needed when no Provider is linked.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description:
Optional JSON object passed to every call to this model, e.g. {"temperature": 0.2, "max_tokens": 1024}. Overrides the same keys in the Provider's Extra Params. Not every provider supports every key.
ParamValueUse
temperature0 – 2How creative the replies are. Use 0 – 0.3 for ERP work (invoice reading, record creation, reports) so answers stay consistent.
max_tokense.g. 1024Upper limit on reply length. Controls cost; set too low and long answers or tool calls get cut off.
top_p0 – 1Alternative to temperature. Keep at 1 and tune temperature instead.
seedintegerMakes replies repeatable for the same input (supported by OpenAI, DeepSeek). Useful when testing agents.
stoplist of stringsThe model stops writing when it produces any of these texts.
frequency_penalty-2 – 2Reduces repeated words. Rarely needed for ERP; leave unset.
presence_penalty-2 – 2Encourages new topics. Rarely needed for ERP; leave unset.
reasoning_effortlow / medium / highFor reasoning models (o-series, GPT-5, Claude, Gemini thinking). Higher means better answers on complex accounting logic, but slower and costlier.
timeoutsecondsHow long to wait for a reply before failing, e.g. 120 for large documents.
num_retriesintegerRetries on temporary provider errors such as rate limits, e.g. 2.
fields.label: Params
